summary: Iteration 4 (FINAL pre-deploy) — Full regression + 4 new AI actions verified live. Backend: 76 prior pytest cases re-run after server.py refactor (1497→120 LOC, 12 routers) → 76 PASS, 1 SKIP (OCR 1x1 dummy by-design). Added /app/backend/tests/test_new_ai_actions.py covering all 4 new AI actions e2e via /api/ai/chat → /api/ai/execute-action with live GPT-5.2: update_payable, delete_payable, transfer_between_banks, generate_pdf_statement (5/5 PASS). PDF action verified end-to-end: generated PDF (>500 bytes, content-type application/pdf), stored in uploads collection, downloadable via /api/uploads/{id}, response carries download_url. Frontend Playwright on /assistant: login OK, all 12 routes navigate OK (Dashboard/Payables/Receivables/Payments/CashBank/CurrentAccounts/Reports/Assistant/Reminders/MasterData/Users/Settings — zero error pages). Suggestions: 6 visible including the 2 new ones (VICTORIA PDF + YAPI KREDİ→DENİZBANK virman). Clicked VICTORIA PDF suggestion → AI returned action JSON → ActionCard rendered with icon 📄 + heading 'PDF Hesap Özeti' + summary + params table (scope_type=ship, scope_value=VICTORIA) + black Confirm + outline Reject. Confirmed → green 'Aksiyon gerçekleştirildi' badge + assistant message with PDF text + 📥 PDF'i İndir button visible (data-testid=btn-download-pdf, wired via authenticated fetch→blob→<a> download). NO regression: all precedent endpoints respond identically post-refactor.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py refactor is clean and idiomatic: 12 focused routers + dependencies.py + database.py singleton. server.py now ~120 LOC as advertised. Good DRY (write_audit/get_current_user shared).
ai_actions.py ACTION_HANDLERS dispatch dict is the right pattern — execute_ai_action in routers/ai.py is now generic and trivially extensible.
handle_generate_pdf_statement does sync file IO (fpath.write_bytes) inside an async handler — for small PDFs (<200KB) acceptable; consider aiofiles if PDFs grow.

handle_transfer_between_banks: uses fx_rate=1 hard-coded for both legs even when currency != USD. _calc_usd handles USD conversion correctly, but fx_rate field should reflect the actual TL/{currency} rate (consistent with handle_create_payment behavior). Cosmetic; reporting uses usd_amount.

Email attachment in PDF action: resend.Emails.send is called via background.add_task with positional dict — Resend Python SDK is sync; works but blocks the background thread briefly. Acceptable for low volume.
_calc_usd silently returns 0 if currency doc missing; iter_3 review already flagged — add logger.warning for observability (also applies to new update_payable when amount/currency change).
Frontend Assistant.jsx downloadFromUrl uses fetch with both Authorization header AND credentials:'include' — redundant but harmless. PDF download verified working in Playwright run.
seed_data_creation: test_new_ai_actions creates ephemeral 'TEST_AI_UPDDEL_VENDOR' payable then exercises AI update/delete on it; transfer test inserts 2 payment rows with is_transfer=true; PDF test writes 1 uploads row + 1 PDF file in /app/backend/uploads/. All small footprint; cleanup is best-effort but does not affect production data.

Live integrations TCMB/GPT-5.2/Resend/MongoDB all green. Nothing pending.
